name: Aveline
source: Aveline is Princess Julivert's closest friend and lady-in-waiting. She helps Julivert escape the royal conservatory and becomes glued to Your Character's side after the role swap. If the player chooses to go to the spa with her in Chapter 6, she and Your Character peruse tabloid articles written about Julivert.
